_comment: Copy this file, fill in your printer, pass it as --printer path/to/yours.json. Every field is explained in docs/ADAPTING_YOUR_PRINTER.md. Values here are the Bambu P1S numbers the discs that played were printed with; fields you delete fall back to them.
name: My printer
_bed: Printable area in mm, and the keep-out from its edge for groove vertices.
_extrusion: Bead width w_e = extrusion_width_factor * nozzle_diameter. Measure it (guide, step 3) and set the factor so w_e matches.
_motion: The groove pass only. Speeds in mm/s, acceleration in mm/s^2, flow in mm^3/s. Keep groove_accel_max at or under your firmware's acceleration limit.
_planner: How many G-code segments per second your firmware sustains without stuttering, and the shortest segment it keeps.
